name: Reject a finding, and it stays rejected after a reload
description: The three defining user actions (run a review, cancel a run, accept/reject a finding) had no end-to-end coverage: flow 04 waits for the 'Reject' button and deliberately never clicks it, because every flow shares one seeded stack. This flow clicks it. It runs LAST so the counts flows 02/04 assert on are still pristine when they run, and it is gated behind E2E_ALLOW_MUTATING=1 so `npm test` aimed at a dev database cannot silently dismiss a real finding — there is no undo in the UI, and re-seeding does not clear dismissed_at. The load-bearing assertion is the RE-NAVIGATION at the end: 'rejected' surviving a fresh page load is what proves the action reached Postgres rather than just React state. Still no model call — the action is a plain PATCH on seeded data.
